summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Poseidon chased through the sea to Cos and buried by breaking off the island called Nisyrum and throwing it upon him.

story.text: Apollodorus says Polybotes was chased through the sea by Poseidon and came to Cos; Poseidon, breaking off that piece of the island which is called Nisyrum, threw it on him. The collective node `gigantes` holds the Gigantomachy; this node is the individual in the battle roster.
